candidates.text: ALSO PURSUANT TO RULE 42 I REMIND ALL IN IN UH THE CHAMBER THAT NO DEMONSTRATION OF APPROVAL OR DISAPPROVAL FROM MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE PERMITTED.
COUNSELOR WEBER SPONSORING A RESOLUTION, UH, LATER IN THE MEETING.

UH, THIS IS AN OFFICIAL RESOLUTION PRESENTED BY BOSTON CITY COUNCIL AT LIBRARY TO LOUIJEUNE BE IT RESOLVED THAT THE BOSTON CITY COUNCIL EXTENDS ITS CONGRATULATIONS TO ALPHA KAPPA ALPHA SORORITY INCORPORATED PSI OMEGA CHA
LET ME JUST READ THIS RESOLUTION.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED THAT THE BOSTON CITY COUNCIL EXTENDS ITS BEST WISHES FOR YOUR CONTINUED SUCCESS THAT THIS RESOLUTION BE DULY SIGNED BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND ATTESTED TO A COPY THEY HAVE TRANSMITTED
NOW ON TO THE FIRST ORDER OF BUSINESS, WHICH IS THE APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES FROM THE MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4TH, 2026.
THE MINUTES OF THE NOVEMBER 4TH MEETING ARE APPROVED.
SO I CAN HAVE A2133 AS WE SEE THE 11 VOTES IN THE AFFIRMATIVE .
REAL UNSUNG HERO AS FAR AS I'M CONCERNED IN THE CITY OF BOSTON.
